chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Whoever dissociates himself from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, whether truthfully or falsely, then Allah has dissociated Himself from him.

key_terms.بَرِئَ: to become dissociated or absolved from
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: a reverential formula meaning Mighty and Majestic

ai.seo_question: What does Imam عليه السلام say about someone who declares dissociation from Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against declaring dissociation from Allah, treating such speech as extremely grave whether said truthfully or falsely. It emphasizes the seriousness of words that violate one's bond with Allah and conveys a severe theological and moral warning.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever disassociates from Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, whether truthfully or falsely, then Allah (swt) has disassociated from him."
